Here's the thing: the shell script doesn't have to be complicated. You just have to respect it. The lesson? Never underestimate the power of simple code. Trust me, you'll thank yourself later.

And the result? A lean, mean shell script — two hundred lines of pure, battle-tested C. Why does this keep happening? I'll tell you why. Because we trust abstractions we have never read!
